mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia which impairs alendronate efficacy and increases risk of bisphosphonate-related adverse effects including osteonecrosis of the jaw and atypical fractures.
action: Monitor serum calcium and magnesium levels regularly; ensure adequate calcium and magnesium supplementation; consider alternative antihypertensive if possible, particularly in patients with osteoporosis requiring bisphosphonate therapy.
